verdict.rationale: First-party docs show programmatic session management: isolated cloud sessions created via API or SDKs, each with a CDP WebSocket endpoint for Playwright or Puppeteer. Concurrency tiers are evidenced only indirectly, by a community remark that pricing includes more concurrency than Browserbase. missing for 10: first-party documentation of concurrency limits per plan, explicit docs on running and managing many parallel sessions (list/stop/fleet operations), hands-on corroboration of fleet-scale concurrency.
